---
applyTo: "**/*.{html,css,scss,js,jsx,ts,tsx,vue,svelte}"
---

Frontend design work should follow this guidance:

- Avoid generic AI-looking layouts.
- Improve typography, spacing, hierarchy, and visual rhythm.
- Avoid repetitive centered hero plus three-card layouts by default.
- Preserve existing product functionality and routes.
- Audit before redesigning.
- Provide specific, code-level improvements instead of vague suggestions.

For deeper frontend design direction, use the installed Taste Skill at `.agents/skills/design-taste-frontend/SKILL.md`.
